definitionZh: :host-context () CSS 伪类允许您根据阴影主机(具有阴影根的元素)及其 DOM 祖先的选择器,在阴影 DOM 内对元素进行不同的样式.
sourceDefinition: The :host-context() CSS pseudo-class allows you to style elements within a shadow DOM differently based on the selector of the shadow host (the element that has the shadow root) and its DOM ancestors.
